libs.note: BH-5566: Dispatcher's collector, run by bin/staff.sh tick dispatcher. It reads the declarations in catalog/staff-feeds.d/ and prints two deterministic checks as staff findings: dead-feed (a declared feed with no success inside its max_age_h) and post-deploy-output (a verified deploy followed by no output for the declared window_h; also one page per output and deploy). Applied by the collector with lib_env_apply staff-dispatcher. Note: docs/notes/2026-10-14-BH-5566-dispatcher.md.

knobs.note: post-deploy-output judges only a verified deploy younger than this. Three days covers a weekend deploy; an older deploy with a dead output is the dead-feed check's job. Out of range is one warn line in logs/staff.log and the default.
The newest deploy ledger rows, fleet-wide, read once per tick when an output is declared (GET /api/ledger?kind=deploy&limit=N; the route caps at 1000).
The bin/lane-alert.sh severity of the post-deploy page: critical, warn, info or off. off sends no page and writes no marker; the finding still flows. Any other value is one warn line and critical.
Test seam: a file the collector sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: the epoch the collector uses for its windows and observedAt, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: the collector reads DSP_FIXTURE and DSP_NOW only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
